name: Answer Questions With Salesforce Documentation
description: Answers a question from a user based on information from relevant Salesforce documentation, including links to source articles. This action is the fallback solution if a user makes a request in Setup to the agent and there’s no action available to complete that request. This action can also be added to the Employee agent in Lightning Experience.

Required Setup.description: If you haven’t set up and configured Data 360, see Data 360 Features and Learning Path.
